svg.title: Accuracy over training, mean of three seeds
svg.desc: Line chart of Test accuracy in % against Training epoch. One series per model, with expected order baseline, +augment, +distill, ours. Shaded 95 percent confidence intervals. Ours is drawn in the foreground. A chance line at 25 labelled chance. N = 3 per point (unit IDs: seed). At the largest training epoch, ours is highest at 81.1 and baseline is lowest at 70. A spread of 11.
